name: Pro Hacker: Ethical Hacking
dev: Learn Ethical Hacking, Programming, Cyber Security

android.desc:
Learn Ethical Hacking with Pro Hacker

Want to learn ethical hacking and understand how cybersecurity professionals protect digital systems? Pro Hacker brings together cybersecurity learning resources, security tools, live threat intelligence, quizzes, AI Security Prompts and incident simulations in one app.

Whether you're looking for ethical hacking for beginners, exploring penetration testing concepts or expanding your existing IT knowledge, Pro Hacker helps you discover security topics, understand emerging threats and develop your technical knowledge.

LEARN ETHICAL HACKING

Start with the fundamentals and explore how security professionals assess vulnerabilities, investigate incidents and protect applications and networks. Build your understanding of ethical hacking, computer networking, Linux and web security through educational resources and technical references.

Explore topics including:
• Ethical hacking fundamentals
• Ethical hacking tutorials and learning resources
• Penetration testing concepts and vulnerability assessment
• Linux and Kali Linux fundamentals
• Network security, ports and protocols
• Web application and API security
• OWASP Top 10 and secure coding
• Bug bounty fundamentals and responsible disclosure
• Authentication, access control and cryptography
• Digital forensics and incident response
• Cloud security and AI application security

CYBER LIVE: CYBERSECURITY NEWS & CVEs

Stay informed about cybersecurity developments, vulnerability disclosures, CVEs and security advisories. Explore emerging threats, understand their potential impact and learn about defensive measures that help organizations protect their systems.

SECURITY TOOLS & TECHNICAL REFERENCES

Explore defensive utilities and technical references designed to help you understand and investigate common technical issues.

Discover network diagnostics, HTTP inspection, security headers, TLS certificate information, critical network ports, protocol references and vulnerability management concepts. Learn how these technologies support security assessment, troubleshooting and defensive analysis.

AI SECURITY PROMPTS

Explore structured AI Security Prompts for technical troubleshooting and security-focused analysis. Use them to help investigate website outages, resource exhaustion and other technical issues. Discover emerging challenges involving AI applications, large language models and secure AI development.

INCIDENT EMULATOR: ANALYZE
